newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Sidanko pretax profit falls in first half.
newsitem.headline: Sidanko pretax profit falls in first half.

text.p: Pretax profit at Russian oil company AOOT Sidanko fell to 246.91 billion roubles in the first half of this year from 817.85 billion in the same period of 1995, the company said on Friday.
NOTES - Comparisons for capital and reserves, accounts receivable and accounts payable December 31, 1995. Comparisons for oil production total 1995, not first half.

Full name AOOT Sibirsko-Dalnevostochnaya Neftanaya Kompaniya. Sidanko is one of a dozen Russian vertically integrated oil groups, whose main production units are Chernogorneft, Varyoganneftegaz and Kondpetroleum.

Interros-Oil won 34 percent of Sidanko at an investment tender last month. Interros-Oil is part of the Interros group which is controlled by Uneximbank and Bank MFK. Bank MFK won control of 51 percent of Sidanko under the government's shares for loans scheme last year.

These figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but to Russian accounting standards, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
